title: A source with only an arXiv id was checked against arXiv alone

found.context: Stage B live run of verify_citations.py against the real indexes

observed_failure: An arXiv-id-only source was looked up in one index, so it was flagged single_index and never triangulated.
expected_behavior: An arXiv id is also looked up through its DataCite DOI (10.48550/arXiv.<id>) in OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar.

resolution.summary: arXiv ids are triangulated through their DataCite DOI
